# Verify final state before finishing
import subprocess

# Check commits
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'log', '--oneline', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Commits on top of base:")
print(result.stdout)

# Check modified files (should only be iterutils.py)
result = subprocess.run(['git', 'diff', '--name-only', 'base..HEAD'], capture_output=True, text=True)
print("Modified files:")
for f in result.stdout.strip().split('\n'):
    print(f"  {f}")

# Run tests one more time
test_files = [
    'tests/test_cacheutils.py', 'tests/test_debugutils_trace.py', 
    'tests/test_dictutils.py', 'tests/test_ecoutils.py', 
    'tests/test_fileutils.py', 'tests/test_formatutils.py', 
    'tests/test_funcutils.py', 'tests/test_funcutils_fb.py', 
    'tests/test_funcutils_fb_py3.py', 'tests/test_gcutils.py', 
    'tests/test_ioutils.py', 'tests/test_iterutils.py', 
    'tests/test_jsonutils.py', 'tests/test_listutils.py', 
    'tests/test_mathutils.py', 'tests/test_namedutils.py', 
    'tests/test_queueutils.py', 'tests/test_setutils.py', 
    'tests/test_socketutils.py', 'tests/test_statsutils.py', 
    'tests/test_statsutils_histogram.py', 'tests/test_strutils.py', 
    'tests/test_tableutils.py', 'tests/test_tbutils.py', 
    'tests/test_tbutils_parsed_exc.py', 'tests/test_timeutils.py', 
    'tests/test_typeutils.py', 'tests/test_urlutils.py'
]

result = subprocess.run(
    ['python', '-m', 'pytest', '-q', '-x', '-p', 'no:cacheprovider'] + test_files,
    capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=120
)
print(f"\nTests: {result.returncode == 0} ({result.stdout[-100:]})")
